title: Sunflower
body:
"Sunflowers are bold, sunny flowers with large, yellow petals and a dark center."

Description

The Sunflower are sellable common flowers, that can be found in the Ferwater regions. It can be sold to Jer Junkman for 100$ per Sunflower. It can be turned into Dye by using a Press Machine.

When put into a Composter, the fill level increases by ~15.65% per flower.
